sentences.text: Essentially, the Petitioner/Accused was the employee of the Respondent No. 2/Complainant, who apparently had stolen the technology, as well as, the speed governing gadgets.

The Respondent No.
2/Complainant's Company previously known as 'Multi Speed Gears Pvt. Ltd.' was engaged in the business of development, manufacturing, marketing and installation of 'speed governors/limiters'
for different varieties of commercial motor vehicles.

The Petitioner joined one of its known Companies 'M/s Zodiac.com Solutions Pvt. Ltd.' as 'Manager Marketing' and later on was transferred to the Company as a 'Technical Head' from 05.01.2007, to carry out work related to approvals from the Government-approved bodies.

It was alleged that the Petitioner dishonestly misappropriated the designs, software and hardware for huge financial consideration and sold it to another Company M/s J.M.S. Enterprises and other unknown persons.
It is stated that the bills submitted by the Petitioner and his technical team, were bogus, inflated and false.
Due to this, the Complainant caused huge loss.

7. On the Complaint of the Respondent No.2/Complainant, FIR No.191/2008 under Section 173(2)
IPC, got registered at Police Station Connaught Place.
On 08.12.2015, Charge-Sheet under Section 408/420/120- B/468/471 has been filed by the IO, before the Patiala House courts, New Delhi.

8. It is stated that the Petitioner and the Respondent No. 2 have amicably settled all the disputes and differences between them and arrived at Settlement dated 06.01.2023, before Samadhan, Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.

entities.text: Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the Settlement, it was inter alia settled between
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/07/2025 at 21:57:02 the parties that the Petitioner will not directly or indirectly, carry on or be engaged, concerned, or interested in any business relating to developing, manufacturing, applying for approval from any Government Authority in India regarding Speed Limiters Device, Vehicle Speed Limiters, Electronic Speed Limiters, Speed Governors, Speed Limiting Equipment or parts thereto or such other Vehicle Speed Limiting Equipment, that are used for controlling the speed of the motor vehicles or any similar activities as being carried out by RAPL in next five years.
It is further settled between the parties that the Petitioner shall not be employed, directly or indirectly in any Firm, Company or other Organization dealing in the same products.
It is settled that the Petitioner shall not disclose any trade secrets of RAPL in future.
9. Today, the AR of the Company, who is present in the Court, states that he has no objection if the said FIR is quashed.
10. The parties have entered into the Settlement voluntarily and without any fear and coercion and undertake to remain bound by the terms of the said Settlement.

11. Considering the facts of the case and that the parties have settled the matter, the FIR No.191/2008 under Section 173(2) IPC, registered at Police Station Connaught Place and all the consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed,
